description: This file implements the Nifty Corners Cube functionality, providing CSS and JavaScript methods to create rounded corners and consistent heights for HTML elements, including fixes for IE8 compatibility.

methods.name: AddCss
methods.description: Adds the CSS stylesheet for nifty corners to the document head.

methods.name: Nifty
methods.description: Main function to apply rounded corners and height adjustments to selected elements based on options.

methods.name: Rounded
methods.description: Applies rounded corners to elements matching the selector with specified options.

methods.name: AddTop
methods.description: Adds top rounded corners to an element.

methods.name: AddBottom
methods.description: Adds bottom rounded corners to an element.

methods.name: CreateStrip
methods.description: Creates a strip element used for corner styling.

methods.name: FixIE
methods.description: Fixes layout issues for IE versions less than 8.

methods.name: SameHeight
methods.description: Sets elements to the same height for layout consistency.

methods.name: getElementsBySelector
methods.description: Retrieves DOM elements matching a complex CSS selector.

methods.name: getParentBk
methods.description: Gets the background color of the parent element.

methods.name: getBk
methods.description: Gets the background color of an element.

methods.name: getPadding
methods.description: Retrieves padding value for a specific side of an element.

methods.name: getStyleProp
methods.description: Gets computed style property of an element.

methods.name: rgb2hex
methods.description: Converts RGB color string to hexadecimal.

methods.name: getIeVersion
methods.description: Detects the version of Internet Explorer.
